The '''Lors''' were a prominent family of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] who enjoyed a close personal friendship with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]. In [[42 ABY]], Admiral Daala, as [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], appointed the young [[Desha Lor]] to serve as the assistant to [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Wynn Dorvan]]. [[Desha Lor's father|Lor's father]] was also an Alliance [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]].
